Priya: Quick draft for tomorrow's T-02:00 UTC release note. Keeping internal + public variants. Need ops to confirm runbook and pin owner.

Priya: ```
Release v2.3.1
- Fix: dispatcher memory leak under burst traffic
- Perf: KV cache heuristics tuned (~15% token cost improvement)
- Ops: canary pin + auto-fallback to v2.2.9 if p99 >200ms for 10m
- No API changes; SDK patch bump only
```

Noah: Add rollback snippet and who runs the pin.

Priya: Rollback CLI: `./deploy rollback --to v2.2.9 --reason "p99>200ms"`
Pin command: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope internal --actor @Noah`

Sam: Ops runbook (brief):
1) T0 run internal pin
2) Monitor p50/p95/p99 + errors for 10m
3) If stable, after 90m flip to public pin
4) If p99>200ms sustained 10m -> run rollback CLI and open incident channel

ops-oncall: Roster: @ops-oncall (primary), @Marta (backup). I'll be watching 01:50-04:00 UTC. Confirmed.

deploy-bot: scheduled window=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, duration=30m, change-id=ch_997123, canary=true, auto-fallback=v2.2.9.

Priya: I will post the internal announce at T-30m with the full runbook. Sam, please attach the short public blurb to the PR for T+90m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/430

Noah: LGTM. I'll execute the pin and stay on the thread. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks everyone, locking this for prep. Ping if anything changes.
